in_sanskrit.name: शर्विकारण
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who protects or is the husband of Goddess Sharvi. Goddess Sharvi is a form of Goddess Parvati, the consort of Lord Shiva.

in_hindi.name: शर्विकारण
in_hindi.meaning: शर्वि का पति या स्वामी, संपर्कवत
in_hindi.long_meaning: शर्वि का पति या स्वामी (Sharvi's husband or master) या संपर्कवत (or the protector).

in_tamil.name: ஷர்விகாரண்
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஷர்வியின் மக்கள் (Sharvi's husband) அல்லவாய் (or Sharvi's protector).

in_telugu.name: షర్వికారణ
in_telugu.long_meaning: షర్వి మహేశ్యపతి (Sharvi's husband, Maharaj) యాదూ షర్వి దేశప్రాజ్జేశ్వర (or Sharvi's lord and protector).

in_marathi.name: Sharvikaaran
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Wealth, Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvikaaran हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharvikaaran is a combination of two words: Sharva and Kaaran. Sharva refers to Lord Shiva, the god of destruction and creation. Kaaran means cause or reason. Therefore, Sharvikaaran is a name for the god of wealth and prosperity, who is believed to be the cause of all creation.

Sharva refers to Lord Shiva, the god of destruction and creation. Kaaran means cause or reason. Therefore, Sharvikaaran is a name for the god of wealth and prosperity, who is believed to be the cause of all creation.
